name: Puebla de Almenara (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red with a notch of the red rising into the white at the centre, charged in the upper hoist with a red cross of Saint James.
history: Municipal flag of Puebla de Almenara; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: division with a rectangular notch at the centre
